name: Moosehead Solar
old_description: We have extensive experience in site surveys and have been specializing in designing, installing, and maintaining a wide variety of solar systems since 1992.
about:
Moosehead Solar was founded in 1992 in Atkinson, Maine. The company began as a specialist in designing, installing, and maintaining solar energy systems for residential customers. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides site surveys, custom system design, installation, and ongoing maintenance for off-grid, grid-tie, and hybrid solar configurations. Its staff evaluates each location to develop tailored solutions that match budget and lifestyle requirements. No facility size or employee count is published.

Moosehead Solar serves homeowners throughout Maine, including remote areas where grid access is limited. Its primary market is residential renewable energy, with a focus on reducing monthly electricity bills through solar-based systems.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: decades of hands-on experience, with the owner having lived off-grid for 30 years; a commitment to sourcing components from top-tier suppliers to ensure durability and cost-effectiveness; and a service-oriented approach that keeps staff available for questions and maintenance support.
